# opnsense_kea_dhcpv6_peer (Data Source)

Reads a typed DHCPv6 HA peer by UUID on OPNsense 26.7.7 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_kea_dhcpv6_peer" "standby" {
  id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Unique DHCPv6 HA peer name.
- `role` (String) DHCPv6 HA role: primary or standby; defaults to primary.
- `url` (String) Control-agent URL of the DHCPv6 peer.
